description: Regression scenarios for the four Phase 5 extensions (owner acknowledgement, prerequisite clause, 'is ready' completion, 'I'll begin'). Positive and negative cases, several domains. Developer-authored; extractor output is scripted.

scenarios.name: X01_ack_generic_commitment
scenarios.description: owner says 'I'll take care of X' about a task they own: acknowledgement, no duplicate

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Sure, I'll take care of the dataset.

scenarios.name: X02_ack_same_verb
scenarios.description: same verb as the existing task also counts as acknowledgement

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
I'll prepare the dataset.

scenarios.name: X03_ack_other_domain
scenarios.description: generalises beyond the dataset example

messages.text: Dev, please write the migration script by Friday.
Sure, I'll handle the migration script.

scenarios.name: X04_neg_different_action_same_object
scenarios.description: a NEW action on the same object is a new task (flagged), not an acknowledgement

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
I'll upload the dataset to the bucket.

TASK: upload the dataset to the bucket

scenarios.name: X05_neg_speaker_does_not_own_the_task
scenarios.description: someone else's commitment is never an acknowledgement of Anushree's task

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
I'll take care of the dataset.

scenarios.name: X06_neg_ambiguous_two_owned_tasks
scenarios.description: speaker owns two tasks about the object: nothing is silently merged

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Anushree, please validate the dataset schema by Friday.
I'll take care of the dataset.

scenarios.name: X07_neg_different_object
scenarios.description: an unrelated commitment from the same person creates a normal task

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
I'll take care of the slides.

scenarios.name: X08_owner_restates_with_another_date
scenarios.description: same action, different deadline -> a date-change proposal on the same task, not a duplicate

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
I'll prepare the dataset by Friday.

scenarios.name: X09_clause_dependency_positive
scenarios.description: '<new task> once <existing task's work>' proposes an edge; creation must be accepted first

messages.text: Dev, please write the migration script by Thursday.
Bianca, please deploy the service once Dev finishes the migration script.

scenarios.name: X10_clause_dependency_after_variant
scenarios.description: works with 'after' and a different object

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Bianca, please train the entity model after the dataset is ready.

scenarios.name: X11_neg_clause_matches_no_task
scenarios.description: a clause about something that is not a tracked task proposes nothing

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Bianca, please send the report once the client approves the budget.

scenarios.name: X12_neg_ambiguous_clause_is_flagged_not_guessed
scenarios.description: the clause matches two tasks: flagged for review, no edge

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Dev, please validate the dataset schema by Friday.
Bianca, please train the model once the dataset is ready.

scenarios.name: X13_neg_temporal_clause_is_not_a_task
scenarios.description: 'once Friday arrives' is a date, not a prerequisite task

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Bianca, please send the report once Friday arrives.

scenarios.name: X14_neg_vague_clause
scenarios.description: 'when you can' names nothing

messages.text: Anushree, please prepare the cleaned dataset by Thursday.
Bianca, please send the report when you can.

scenarios.name: X15_ready_completes_the_matched_task
scenarios.description: '<noun phrase> is ready' completes a matching task (other domain)

messages.text: Dev, please write the migration script by Friday.
The migration script is ready.

scenarios.name: X16_neg_ready_false_cues
scenarios.description: pronoun subjects, 'ready to', questions, conditionals and negations never complete

messages.text: Dev, please write the migration script by Friday.
We are ready to start.
I am ready for the meeting.
Is the migration script ready?
Please tell me when the migration script is ready.
The migration script is not ready yet.

scenarios.name: X17_neg_ready_for_something_unrelated
scenarios.description: 'ready' about an untracked object finds no referent and changes nothing

messages.text: Dev, please write the migration script by Friday.
The conference room is ready.

scenarios.name: X18_neg_ready_is_ambiguous_between_tasks
scenarios.description: two tasks about the object: no guess

messages.text: Dev, please write the migration script by Friday.
Dev, please review the migration script by Monday.
The migration script is ready.

scenarios.name: X19_begin_now_updates_status
scenarios.description: 'I'll begin training now' -> in progress (with 'now' extracted as a TEMPORAL span)

messages.text: Bianca, please train the entity model by Friday.
I'll begin training now.
I'll start training now.

scenarios.name: X20_neg_deferred_start
scenarios.description: a start deferred to another time is not a status change

messages.text: Bianca, please train the entity model by Friday.
I'll start training tomorrow.

scenarios.name: X21_neg_start_of_something_else
scenarios.description: starting an untracked activity changes no task

messages.text: Bianca, please train the entity model by Friday.
I'll begin the review now.

scenarios.name: X22_start_variants
scenarios.description: start / begin / kick off all work; a third person's statement is flagged by owner checks, not guessed

messages.text: Bianca, please train the entity model by Friday.
I will kick off training now.

scenarios.name: Y01_claim_unowned_task
scenarios.description: 'I can review the slides' about an unassigned task assigns it to the speaker, no duplicate

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
I can review the slides.

scenarios.name: Y02_claim_with_pronoun_object
scenarios.description: 'I can review them' still finds the single unassigned review task

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
I can review them.

scenarios.name: Y03_claim_ambiguous_between_two_unowned_tasks
scenarios.description: two unassigned slide tasks: options are shown, nothing is guessed, the reviewer chooses

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
Can someone review the slides for the client deck?

TASK: review the slides for the client deck

messages.text: I can review the slides.

scenarios.name: Y04_neg_task_owned_by_someone_else_is_not_claimed
scenarios.description: a volunteer cannot take over a task that already has an owner

messages.text: Dev, please review the slides by Friday.
I can review the slides.

scenarios.name: Y05_neg_different_action_on_the_same_object
scenarios.description: an unassigned 'review the slides' task is not claimed by 'I can print the slides'

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
I can print the slides.

scenarios.name: Y06_neg_closed_unowned_task_is_ignored
scenarios.description: a canceled unassigned task cannot be claimed

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
Please cancel the slides.
I can review the slides.

scenarios.name: Y07_neg_a_request_to_someone_else_is_not_a_claim
scenarios.description: 'Can you review the slides?' asks someone else; it is not a volunteer claim

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
Bianca, can you review the slides?

scenarios.name: Y08_neg_joint_commitment_is_not_a_solo_claim
scenarios.description: 'Ellen and I will review the slides' commits two people; it must not assign the task to the speaker alone

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
Ellen and I will review the slides.

scenarios.name: Y09_neg_joint_can_is_not_a_solo_claim
scenarios.description: 'Riya and I can review the slides' is not the speaker volunteering alone

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
Riya and I can review the slides.

scenarios.name: Y10_neg_question_is_not_a_claim
scenarios.description: 'Can I review the slides?' asks permission, it does not take the task

messages.text: Can someone review the slides?
Can I review the slides?

scenarios.name: Z01_ctx_completion_without_task_span
scenarios.description: 'The dataset is cleaned.' completes the existing 'clean the dataset' task although no TASK span is present (context_lifecycle on)

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
The dataset is cleaned.

scenarios.name: Z02_neg_ctx_completion_off_is_phase5_behaviour
scenarios.description: the same sentence does nothing when context_lifecycle is off

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
The dataset is cleaned.

scenarios.name: Z03_neg_ctx_completion_other_object
scenarios.description: 'The desk is cleaned.' shares the verb but no object with the task

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
The desk is cleaned.

scenarios.name: Z04_neg_ctx_completion_question
scenarios.description: a question about completion is not a completion

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Is the dataset cleaned?

scenarios.name: Z05_neg_ctx_completion_conditional
scenarios.description: 'Once the dataset is cleaned, I will start.' is a plan, not a report

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Once the dataset is cleaned, I will start.

scenarios.name: Z06_neg_ctx_completion_negated
scenarios.description: 'The dataset is not cleaned yet.' must not complete it

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
The dataset is not cleaned yet.

scenarios.name: Z07_ctx_ack_without_task_span
scenarios.description: 'Sure, I'll take care of it.' by the only owner is recognised as an acknowledgement, not ignored

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Sure, I'll take care of it.

scenarios.name: Z08_neg_ctx_ack_owner_has_two_tasks
scenarios.description: with two open tasks 'I'll take care of it' is not attributed to either

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Anushree, please review the slides by Friday.
Sure, I'll take care of it.

scenarios.name: Z09_neg_ctx_ack_by_non_owner
scenarios.description: a non-owner saying 'I'll take care of it' is not an acknowledgement of someone else's task

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
I'll take care of it.

scenarios.name: Z10_imperative_passes_the_create_gate
scenarios.description: a bare imperative marked by the grammar stage creates a (flagged) task instead of being ignored

messages.text: Write a report.

scenarios.name: Z11_neg_same_phrase_without_the_imperative_mark
scenarios.description: without the mark the Phase 5 gate still refuses a task-like phrase with no request, owner or deadline

messages.text: Write a report.

scenarios.name: Z12_clause_hint_points_at_existing_task
scenarios.description: a refinement hint ('once Anushree finishes the dataset') makes the new task depend on the EXISTING dataset task

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Bianca, train the model once Anushree finishes the dataset.

scenarios.name: Z13_neg_hint_matches_no_task
scenarios.description: a prerequisite that names no existing task ('after lunch') proposes no dependency

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Bianca, train the model after lunch.

scenarios.name: Z14_neg_hint_is_ambiguous_between_two_tasks
scenarios.description: a prerequisite matching two tasks equally is flagged for the reviewer, never guessed

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the dataset by Thursday.
Anushree, please validate the dataset by Friday.
Bianca, train the model after the dataset is ready.

scenarios.name: Z15_reference_to_reference_dependency
scenarios.description: 'The build can't start until the test server is set up' links two EXISTING tasks

messages.text: Anushree, please set up the test server by Thursday.
Bianca, please deploy the build by Friday.
The build can't start until the test server is set up.

hints.prerequisite: the test server is set up

scenarios.name: Z16_neg_reference_to_reference_unmatched
scenarios.description: if one side matches no task, nothing is proposed

messages.text: Anushree, please set up the test server by Thursday.
The launch can't start until the test server is set up.

hints.prerequisite: the test server is set up
